newsitem.title: UK: Pearson up on broker revaluation.
newsitem.headline: Pearson up on broker revaluation.

text.p: Shares in Pearson Plc rose on Tuesday as a report in the Daily Mail newspaper highlighted an increased valuation on the stock from Henderson Crosthwaite, traders said.
The stock was up 12-1/2p at 729-1/2 by 1113 GMT.
Analyst Louise Barton at Henderson raised her break-up value of Pearson to 970p per share from 900p after updating her valuation of the component parts of the company.
Barton believes that the new management team will squeeze a higher performance from assets in the current year.
Last month Pearson announced the appointment of Marjorie Scardino as chief executive and Dennis Stevenson as new chairman of the group.
